about.text: This en banc court convened to reconsider a panel decision holding that Section 241 of the Mississippi Constitution, which disenfranchises those convicted of certain felony offenses, fails the test of the Eighth Amendment, as incorporated by the Fourteenth Amendment’s Due Process Clause.
